61 wickets. Nobody has taken more in Betway SA20 history.
Ottneil Baartman heads into Season 5 as the league's all-time leading wicket-taker, but Marco Jansen is just one behind on 60. The race is on.
From Sunrisers Eastern Cape to Paarl Royals, Baartman has been the man for the big breakthrough, taking match-changing wickets across the first four seasons.
BY THE NUMBERS:
61 - the most wickets in Betway SA20 history
1 - the gap between Baartman and Marco Jansen (60)
Season 5 - where the record could change hands.
